name: Elizabeth Bennet
summary: The Bennet daughter whose quick wit turns an overheard insult into a story for her friends.

fields.label: In the excerpt
fields.value: Lively, playful; amused by the ridiculous.

name: Jane Bennet
summary: The eldest Bennet daughter. Bingley singles her out at the assembly and dances with her twice.

fields.label: In the excerpt
fields.value: Her pleasure at the ball is quieter than her mother's.

name: Mr. Bennet
summary: He quietly visits Bingley while letting his family believe he has refused. His teasing leaves his wife struggling to understand him.

fields.label: In the excerpt
fields.value: Quick parts, sarcastic humor, reserve, and caprice.

name: Mrs. Bennet
summary: Bingley's arrival offers a marriage prospect for her daughters. She pushes for an introduction, then celebrates Jane's success and resents Darcy.

fields.label: In the excerpt
fields.value: Visiting, news, and finding husbands for her daughters.

name: Mary Bennet
summary: She tries to offer a thoughtful observation in the family conversation. At the assembly she hears herself praised as accomplished.

name: Catherine Bennet
summary: Her coughing irritates her mother during the conversation about Bingley. She and Lydia enjoy being supplied with partners at the ball.

name: Lydia Bennet
summary: The youngest Bennet daughter points out that she is the tallest. At the assembly, having partners matters more to her than anything else.

name: Mr. Bingley
summary: Netherfield's new tenant is sociable, good-looking, and delighted with the assembly. He urges Darcy to dance and admires Jane.

name: Mr. Darcy
summary: Bingley's wealthy friend initially draws admiration, then alienates the room. Elizabeth overhears him dismiss her as a potential dance partner.

fields.label: In the excerpt
fields.value: Fastidious; reluctant to dance with strangers.

name: Miss Bingley
summary: One of Bingley's fashionable sisters. Darcy dances with her at the assembly.

name: Mrs. Hurst
summary: Bingley's married sister attends the assembly with her husband. Darcy dances with her.

fields.label: In the excerpt
fields.value: Fashionable member of the Netherfield party.

name: Mr. Hurst
summary: Bingley's brother-in-law is part of the five-person party that arrives at the assembly.

fields.label: In the excerpt
fields.value: Introduced largely through appearance and company.

name: Longbourn
summary: The village where the Bennets live. The family returns here after the assembly.

fields.label: In the excerpt
fields.value: Domestic conversations frame the social outing.

name: Netherfield Park
summary: The estate rented by Bingley. Its new tenant becomes the subject of neighborhood speculation.

fields.label: In the excerpt
fields.value: The reported fortune makes the tenancy socially significant.

name: The assembly room
summary: The public dance where Bingley meets the neighborhood and Elizabeth overhears Darcy's judgment.

fields.label: In the excerpt
fields.value: Introductions and dance partners make private judgments public.

name: Mrs. Long
summary: Neighbor whose news about Netherfield starts the Bennets' conversation. Mrs. Bennet doubts she will help with an introduction because she has two nieces of her own.

fields.label: In the excerpt
fields.value: Mentioned in chapters 1-2; not shown directly in the narrated action.

name: Mr. Morris
summary: The person reported to have arranged the letting of Netherfield to Bingley.

fields.label: In the excerpt
fields.value: Mentioned in Mrs. Long's account in chapter 1.

name: Lady Lucas
summary: Neighbor who supplies a favorable report of Bingley and reassures Mrs. Bennet about his trip to London.

fields.label: In the excerpt
fields.value: Reported conversations in chapter 3; no direct speech in the excerpt.

name: Sir William Lucas
summary: Lady Lucas reports his favorable impression of Bingley.

name: Miss Lucas
summary: Bingley's first dance partner at the assembly, according to Mrs. Bennet's report.

fields.label: In the excerpt
fields.value: A reported dance partner in chapter 3; no scene appearance tag.

name: Maria Lucas
summary: A dance partner named by Mrs. Bennet when recounting Bingley's evening.
